Buyers and Sellers.Title: Property Listing Management
Buyers and Sellers.Description: Create a seamless interface for sellers to list their properties with detailed attributes such as location, price, and descriptions, and allow buyers to easily browse and filter these listings.

User Stories.Title: User Story 1: Property Listing Creation
User Stories.Description: As a Seller, I want to create property listings with details such as location, price, images, and descriptions so that I can attract potential buyers.
AcceptanceCriteria: A form is available for sellers to input property details including location, price, and descriptions.
Sellers can upload images of the property.
Listings can be previewed before submission to ensure accuracy.
Listings are immediately searchable upon approval.

User Stories.Title: User Story 2: Property Listing Search
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer, I want to search for properties using filters like location, price, and property type so that I can find listings that match my needs efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyers can filter search results by location, price range, and property type.
Search results update in real-time as filters are applied.
Search results display essential details such as location, price, and one thumbnail image.

User Stories.Title: User Story 3: Property Details Viewing
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer, I want to view detailed information about properties including a photo gallery, detailed descriptions, and contact information so that I can make informed decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Detailed pages for each property listing are accessible.
Each detailed page includes a photo gallery, comprehensive property descriptions, and seller contact information.
Information is presented in a clear, easy-to-read format.

User Stories.Title: User Story 4: Property Listing Management
User Stories.Description: As a Seller, I want to manage my listed properties, update details, or remove listings so that I can keep the information accurate and up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Sellers can easily access a dashboard of their listed properties.
Options to edit or remove listings are clearly available.
Changes to listings are reflected in real-time across the platform.

User Stories.Title: User Story 5: Property Favorites and Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer, I want to save favorite properties and receive notifications on updates so that I can stay informed about properties I am interested in.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyers can mark properties as 'favorites'.
A favorites list is accessible to view anytime.
Notifications are sent to buyers when there is a significant update on any of their favorite properties.

Buyers and Sellers.Title: Transaction Handling
Buyers and Sellers.Description: Develop a robust system to manage the end-to-end transaction process for buyers and sellers, including offers, counteroffers, and closing transactions digitally.

User Stories.Title: Create Offer Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer, I want to be able to create and submit offers on properties digitally so that I can efficiently propose a purchase price without the need for physical meetings or paperwork.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer can enter an offer amount through the app interface.
Buyer can attach necessary documents directly within the app.
System verifies the offer details before submission to ensure all required fields are filled.
Confirmation is sent to both buyer and seller once the offer is submitted.

User Stories.Title: View Offers
User Stories.Description: As a Seller, I want to view all offers made on my listed properties in a consolidated dashboard so that I can easily compare and manage incoming offers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Seller can see a list of all current offers on their dashboard.
Offers should be sortable by date, amount, and buyer rating if available.
System allows seller to open and view the details of each offer.

User Stories.Title: Counteroffer Capability
User Stories.Description: As a Seller, I want to be able to make counteroffers directly through the app so that I can negotiate prices more dynamically and efficiently with potential buyers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Seller can select an existing offer and submit a counteroffer.
System prompts seller to confirm the counteroffer before sending.
Buyer receives notification of the counteroffer and can view it in their app.

User Stories.Title: Accept/Reject Offers
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer, I want the option to accept or reject counteroffers through the app so that I can quickly move forward or continue negotiating on property transactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer receives notification of a counteroffer and can access it in the app.
Buyer has the option to accept or reject the counteroffer with a single tap.
System updates both parties about the status of the offer/counteroffer once a decision is made.

User Stories.Title: Digital Transaction Closing
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer, I want to finalize and close transactions digitally after accepting an offer so that I can secure the property without unnecessary delays or physical paperwork.
AcceptanceCriteria: Buyer can initiate closing of the transaction in the app once an offer is accepted.
System prompts for any final confirmations or additional required information.
Both parties receive digital receipts and copies of the transaction documents upon successful closing.

User Stories.Title: Transaction History
User Stories.Description: As a Seller, I want to access a history of all my transactions, including offers and sales, so that I can keep track of my activity and analyze my selling performance over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Seller can view a historical log of all transactions on their account.
Transaction log includes dates, amounts, buyer details, and status (completed, in progress, rejected).
System allows filtering and searching within the transaction history.

Buyers and Sellers.Title: Real-Time Analytics for Market Trends
Buyers and Sellers.Description: Provide buyers and sellers with real-time analytics on market trends, property valuations, and other relevant data to help them make informed decisions.

User Stories.Title: View Real-Time Property Valuations
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to view real-time valuations for properties so that I can make informed pricing decisions quickly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Property valuations are updated in real-time.
Valuations reflect current market trends and data.
Users can access valuation data for any listed property.

User Stories.Title: Access Market Trend Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want access to a dashboard displaying current market trends so that I can understand the best times to buy or sell.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays real-time market trends.
Trends are represented through graphs and charts.
Dashboard is accessible on both mobile and web platforms.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications on Market Changes
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to receive notifications about significant market changes so that I can take timely actions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications are sent in real-time as market conditions change.
Users can customize the types of notifications they receive.
Notifications include actionable data and suggestions.

User Stories.Title: Compare Property Prices
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to compare prices of similar properties in the same area so that I can list my property at a competitive rate or make a reasonable offer.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can select properties to compare based on location, size, and features.
Comparison results are displayed in an easy-to-understand format.
The feature includes historical price data for reference.

User Stories.Title: Generate Custom Reports
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to generate custom reports based on my preferences for market data so that I can have detailed insights tailored to my needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can select specific data points for the report.
Reports can be generated in various formats (PDF, Excel).
The system allows saving and sharing of reports directly from the platform.

Buyers and Sellers.Title: Integrated Communication Tools
Buyers and Sellers.Description: Implement communication tools within the app to enable direct and secure communication between buyers and sellers to negotiate deals and exchange information.

User Stories.Title: Secure Messaging Platform
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to be able to send and receive messages securely within the app so that I can communicate confidentially with other parties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Messages must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Only authenticated users can send and receive messages.
Users must receive notifications for new messages.

User Stories.Title: Direct Messaging with Contact List
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to be able to directly message any buyer or seller listed on the app so that I can quickly negotiate deals or exchange information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can search for and select any buyer or seller from a contact list within the app.
Users can initiate a direct message from the contact profile.
The system must log and display message history between users.

User Stories.Title: File Sharing in Chat
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to share files directly through the chat interface so that I can easily exchange documents necessary for transactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can attach and send files within the messaging interface.
Supported file types include PDF, DOCX, and JPEG.
The system must scan files for viruses before sending or opening.

User Stories.Title: Message Read Receipts
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to see read receipts for the messages I send so that I know when my message is read by the recipient.
AcceptanceCriteria: Read receipts are displayed only when the recipient opens the message.
Users can toggle off sending read receipts in their privacy settings.
Read receipts must be updated in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Scheduled Messages
User Stories.Description: As a seller, I want to schedule messages to be sent at a later time so that I can manage communication with buyers efficiently, according to my availability.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can write a message and set a specific time for the message to be sent.
The system must store the message and deliver it at the scheduled time.
Users must be able to view, edit, or delete scheduled messages before they are sent.

Buyers and Sellers.Title: Secure Document Handling and Storage
Buyers and Sellers.Description: Ensure secure handling, signing, and storage of documents such as contracts and legal papers necessary for property transactions.

User Stories.Title: Secure Document Upload
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer or Seller, I want to securely upload documents related to property transactions so that I can ensure my sensitive information is protected against unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: Document upload feature supports multiple file formats (PDF, Docx).
All uploaded documents are encrypted.
Users receive confirmation of secure upload.

User Stories.Title: Document E-Signing
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer or Seller, I want to sign documents electronically within the app so that I can efficiently complete transactions without the need for face-to-face meetings.
AcceptanceCriteria: E-signature feature complies with legal standards.
Users can sign documents directly in the app interface.
Document status updates to 'Signed' after all parties have completed their signatures.

User Stories.Title: Access Controlled Document Viewing
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer or Seller, I want to control who can view my transaction documents so that I can maintain privacy and restrict access to only relevant parties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can set permissions for who can view each document.
Unauthorized attempts to access documents are logged and reported.
Users can review and modify permissions as needed.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Document Status Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer or Seller, I want to track the status of my documents (e.g., uploaded, pending signature, completed) so that I can stay informed about the progress of my transactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Document status is visibly updated in real-time on the user's dashboard.
Notifications are sent to users when there is a status change.
A history log of all status changes is available for each document.

User Stories.Title: Secure Document Storage and Retrieval
User Stories.Description: As a Buyer or Seller, I want to securely store my completed documents in the app and retrieve them anytime so that I can ensure long-term safety and accessibility of my legal records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Stored documents are encrypted at rest.
Users can easily search for and retrieve documents from their account.
Access logs are maintained for all document retrievals.

Buyers and Sellers.Title: User Verification and Authentication
Buyers and Sellers.Description: Enhance security by implementing a robust user verification and authentication system to protect the interests of both buyers and sellers.

User Stories.Title: Multi-Factor Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to have multi-factor authentication when logging in so that my account is more secure against unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: User must be prompted to authenticate using two methods: password and a code sent to their email or phone.
The system must verify both credentials before granting access.
If the second factor is incorrect, the user should be prevented from logging in and receive a notification of the attempted access.

User Stories.Title: Secure Password Reset
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to be able to securely reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account without compromising security.
AcceptanceCriteria: The password reset process should require the user to verify their identity via email or SMS.
New passwords must comply with security standards (minimum length, complexity).
Users should receive a confirmation email once the password has been changed.

User Stories.Title: Biometric Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want to use biometric authentication (fingerprint or facial recognition) for accessing the app so that my login process is both secure and convenient.
AcceptanceCriteria: The app should support fingerprint and facial recognition features based on device capability.
Authentication must be processed securely and locally on the device.
Users should have the option to fallback to password authentication if the biometric check fails.

User Stories.Title: Role-Based Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want the system to enforce role-based access controls so that users can only access information and functionalities relevant to their role, ensuring data privacy and integrity.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must categorize users into roles and restrict access to data and functionalities not related to their role.
Changes in user roles should update access rights immediately.
Unauthorized access attempts should be logged and reported.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Transmission
User Stories.Description: As a buyer or seller, I want all data transmitted between my device and the server to be encrypted so that my personal and transaction data are protected against eavesdropping.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data transmissions must use HTTPS.
Encryption methods should meet current industry standards for security.
The system should regularly update its encryption methods to adapt to new security challenges.

Property Owners.Title: Property Management Integration
Property Owners.Description: Develop a comprehensive module within the app that enables property owners to efficiently manage their properties, including functionalities such as listing properties for sale or rent, tracking and managing multiple properties, and receiving notifications about property status changes.

User Stories.Title: Property Listing Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to list my properties for sale or rent with all necessary details so that potential buyers or renters can easily find and evaluate my offerings.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to input property details such as location, price, size, number of rooms, and photos.
Options to categorize the property as 'For Sale' or 'For Rent'.
Features to update or remove listings as required.
Property listings should be visible to authenticated users based on their role and permissions.

User Stories.Title: Multi-Property Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a dashboard that provides an overview of all my listed properties so that I can easily manage and review them at a glance.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard should display key information on each property, such as status, inquiries, and upcoming viewings.
Ability to access detailed views from the dashboard for specific properties.
Features for sorting and filtering properties based on criteria like status, location, or price.
Real-time updates on property status and notifications.

User Stories.Title: Property Status Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to receive notifications about significant status changes and inquiries for my properties so that I can respond promptly to potential buyers or tenants.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications for events such as new inquiries, offers, or changes in rental status.
Customizable notification settings to select preferred types of alerts and their frequency.
Notifications should be accessible both via the app and as email alerts.
Ensure timely delivery of notifications without delays.

User Stories.Title: Financial Overview for Properties
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a feature that provides financial insights and analytics for my properties so that I can make informed decisions about property management and investment.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to view financial statistics such as rental income, expenses, and occupancy rates.
Features to compare financial performance across different properties.
Graphical representations of financial data over selectable time periods.
Insights should be based on real-time data and accurate calculations.

User Stories.Title: Maintenance Management Integration
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to manage maintenance requests and schedules for my properties so that I can maintain them efficiently and keep tenants satisfied.
AcceptanceCriteria: Capability to log and track maintenance requests submitted by tenants or identified by inspections.
Function to schedule and confirm maintenance with service providers.
Status updates and history tracking for each maintenance job.
Integration with calendars for reminders about upcoming maintenance and checks.

Property Owners.Title: Financial Management Tools
Property Owners.Description: Create tools for property owners to handle financial aspects related to property management, such as tracking rental payments, calculating expenses, and managing financial reports to streamline their financial oversight.

User Stories.Title: User Story 1: Rental Payment Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a feature to track all rental payments so that I can ensure timely collection and monitor any overdue payments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to log and track each tenant's payment status (paid, pending, overdue).
Notifications for upcoming and overdue payments.
A dashboard showing all payment statuses in one view.
Integration with bank accounts to automatically update payment status when transaction is detected.

User Stories.Title: User Story 2: Expense Management System
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a system to record and categorize property-related expenses so that I can manage and optimize my spending.
AcceptanceCriteria: Capability to input and store various types of expenses (maintenance, taxes, utilities etc.).
Function to categorize expenses for better tracking and reporting.
Reports showing monthly, quarterly, and yearly spend on each category.
Ability to upload and store receipts and invoices.

User Stories.Title: User Story 3: Financial Reporting Tool
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a tool to generate financial reports so that I can have a comprehensive view of the financial health of my properties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Generate monthly, quarterly, and yearly financial reports.
Reports include total income, expenses, and net profit.
Option to customize reports by properties or overall portfolio.
Export reports in PDF and Excel formats.

User Stories.Title: User Story 4: Tax Calculation Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a feature that calculates the tax implications of my rental income and expenses so that I can comply with tax regulations without manual calculations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Automatically calculate taxes based on rental income and deductible expenses.
Update tax calculation rules based on latest local tax laws.
Provide a breakdown of taxable amount and possible deductions.
Option to export tax calculation reports for filing purposes.

User Stories.Title: User Story 5: Dashboard for Financial Overview
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a dashboard that provides a real-time financial overview of all my properties so that I can make informed decisions quickly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time display of income, expenses, net profit, and tax obligations.
Interactive charts and graphs for visual representation of financial data.
Customizable view options to focus on specific properties or overall portfolio.
Updates automatically as new data is entered or modified.

Property Owners.Title: Service Booking System
Property Owners.Description: Implement a system that allows property owners to book and manage services related to property maintenance, including scheduling repairs, regular maintenance, and managing service provider contracts directly from the app.

User Stories.Title: Service Scheduling Interface
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to schedule maintenance and repair services through the app, so that I can manage property upkeep efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can select the type of service needed (e.g., plumbing, electrical, HVAC).
Users can choose a specific service provider from a list of available providers.
Users can pick a date and time for the service from the provider's available slots.
The system confirms the booking and sends a notification to both the user and the service provider.

User Stories.Title: Service Provider Contract Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to manage contracts with service providers directly within the app, so that I can easily handle legal and payment details.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to upload, review, and digitally sign contracts with service providers.
Feature to send and receive updates or amendments to contracts.
Notifications for contract renewal or expiration dates.
Secure storage and easy retrieval of contracts within the app.

User Stories.Title: Maintenance History Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to view and track the history of all maintenance activities, so that I can monitor the upkeep of my properties over time.
AcceptanceCriteria: A comprehensive history log of all past services, sortable by date, type, or property.
Ability to add notes or upload documents (e.g., receipts, warranties) related to each service event.
Option to generate reports based on the maintenance history for individual or multiple properties.
System should provide reminders for upcoming maintenance based on past services and intervals suggested by providers.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Service Status Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to receive real-time updates about the status of scheduled services, so that I can be informed about the progress and any changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time notifications when a service provider starts a job at the property.
Updates when the job status changes (e.g., in progress, completed, delayed).
Final summary upon job completion, including a time log and brief report from the service provider.
Ability for users to provide immediate feedback or rate the service post-completion.

User Stories.Title: Budget and Expense Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to track the expenses related to property maintenance within the app, so that I can manage my budget more effectively.
AcceptanceCriteria: Feature to record and categorize expenses related to each service.
Integration with financial management tools to analyze spending trends.
Option to set budget limits for different categories of maintenance services.
Alerts when approaching or exceeding budget limits.

Property Owners.Title: Owner Communication Portal
Property Owners.Description: Establish a communication platform within the app that facilitates seamless communication between property owners, tenants, real estate agents, and service providers, enhancing coordination and resolving issues promptly.

User Stories.Title: Property Owner Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a personalized dashboard so that I can have an overview of all my properties, ongoing issues, and active communications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays a summary of all owned properties
Dashboard shows notifications for new messages and unresolved issues
Dashboard provides quick access to detailed property pages and communication threads

User Stories.Title: Direct Messaging to Tenants and Agents
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to send direct messages to tenants and real estate agents so that I can address issues and coordinate activities without delays.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to initiate new messages from the owner dashboard
Real-time delivery and notification of messages
Messages are securely stored and accessible only to intended recipients

User Stories.Title: Issue Reporting and Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a feature to report and track issues so that I can ensure they are resolved in a timely manner.
AcceptanceCriteria: Owners can report new issues related to a property directly through the app
Tracking system for issue status from reported to resolved
Notifications for any updates or changes in the issue status

User Stories.Title: Service Provider Coordination
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to coordinate with service providers directly through the app so that I can schedule and manage necessary property maintenance and services efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to view and select service providers listed in the app
Feature to schedule and confirm service appointments
Integration of service history and upcoming schedules on the property dashboard

User Stories.Title: Document Sharing and Management
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a secure way to share and manage documents related to properties, tenancies, and services so that I can keep all relevant records in one place and easily accessible.
AcceptanceCriteria: Secure uploading and storing of documents
Permission controls to allow document access to specific users (tenants, agents)
Ability to categorize and retrieve documents efficiently

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to receive real-time notifications about important events (e.g., lease expiries, maintenance updates) so that I can take necessary actions promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Push notifications for critical events directly to the owner’s mobile device
Customizable notification settings to specify which events to be notified about
Notifications are actionable leading directly to relevant features in the app

Property Owners.Title: Security and Privacy Enhancements
Property Owners.Description: Enhance the app with robust security measures to protect sensitive information and transactions related to property ownership and management, ensuring that property owners can operate with confidence in the security of their data.

User Stories.Title: Implement Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to ensure that access to my account is secured through Multi-Factor Authentication so that unauthorized access is prevented.
AcceptanceCriteria: Upon login, the user is required to authenticate through two or more verification methods.
Support for authentication methods such as SMS, email, and authenticator apps.
A fallback mechanism is in place for recovery options if one of the authentication methods is unavailable.

User Stories.Title: Secure Property Transaction Data
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want all transaction data to be encrypted so that sensitive information is protected against unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data related to property transactions must be encrypted both in transit and at rest.
Use of industry-standard encryption protocols such as AES-256.
Regular security audits to ensure compliance with the latest security standards.

User Stories.Title: Role-Based Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want the system to implement role-based access controls so that only authorized users can access specific functionalities based on their roles.
AcceptanceCriteria: Different user roles (e.g., owner, manager, agent) have access to functionalities pertinent to their job responsibilities.
Unauthorized access attempts are logged and alerts are sent to the administrator.
Regular review and updates to access permissions to ensure they reflect current operational needs.

User Stories.Title: Audit Trails for User Activities
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want the system to maintain audit logs of all user activities so that there is a traceable history of actions for security and compliance purposes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Every user action within the platform is logged with user ID, timestamp, and action details.
Audit logs are protected from unauthorized access and modification.
Logs are retained for a minimum period as required by law or regulatory requirements.

User Stories.Title: Real-time Security Alerts
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to receive real-time alerts for any suspicious activities so that immediate action can be taken to mitigate potential threats.
AcceptanceCriteria: Implementation of an anomaly detection system to monitor and flag unusual activity.
Real-time alerts are sent to the user's email and mobile device.
System provides actionable steps for users to address the detected issue.

Property Owners.Title: Analytics and Reporting
Property Owners.Description: Provide property owners with advanced analytics tools to gain insights into property performance, market trends, and investment returns, helping them make informed decisions about their real estate investments.

User Stories.Title: Dashboard for Real-Time Property Performance Metrics
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a dashboard that displays real-time metrics on my properties' performance so that I can easily monitor key indicators such as occupancy rates, rental income, and maintenance costs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays real-time data.
Metrics include occupancy rates, rental income, and maintenance costs.
Data is automatically updated without user intervention.
Accessible via both mobile and web platforms.

User Stories.Title: Market Trends Analysis Tool
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a tool that analyzes and displays current market trends so that I can understand how my properties compare to the market and identify potential investment opportunities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tool provides comparative analysis between personal property performance and general market trends.
Includes data visualization (graphs, charts).
Updates in real-time as new market data becomes available.
User can customize the type of market data displayed.

User Stories.Title: Investment Return Calculator
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want a calculator that can predict investment returns based on current and historical data so that I can make informed decisions about future investments or sales.
AcceptanceCriteria: Calculator allows input of various parameters (purchase price, renovation costs, expected rental income, etc.).
Displays projected return on investment (ROI) and break-even analysis.
Incorporates both historical data and predictive analytics.
Results can be exported to Excel or PDF formats.

User Stories.Title: Notification System for Investment Tips
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to receive notifications about investment tips based on analytics so that I can take immediate action on potential profitable moves or necessary adjustments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications are based on real-time analytics and market trends.
Tips include when to buy, sell, or hold properties.
Users can customize the frequency and types of notifications received.
Notifications can be received via app notifications, email, or SMS.

User Stories.Title: Customizable Reports Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Property Owner, I want to generate customizable reports that include detailed analytics of property performance and market conditions so that I can have tailored insights for meetings or personal analysis.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can select which data points to include in the report (e.g., financial performance, tenant demographics, maintenance costs).
Reports can be generated on a scheduled basis or on demand.
Supports various formats for the report (e.g., PDF, PowerPoint).
Allows sharing of reports directly from the platform via email or integrated cloud storage.

Real Estate Agents.Title: Property Listings Management
Real Estate Agents.Description: Enable real estate agents to list, update, and manage properties efficiently on the platform, including details like location, price, images, and specifications.

User Stories.Title: User Story 1: Property Listing Creation
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to create property listings with details like location, price, images, and specifications so that potential buyers and renters can easily find properties that meet their needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Agent can enter location, price, images, and specifications for a property.
Listing must include at least one image and all fields are required except additional images.
New listings should be visible on the platform within minutes after submission.

User Stories.Title: User Story 2: Property Listing Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to update property listings to reflect changes in price, availability, and property specifications so that the information remains accurate and current.
AcceptanceCriteria: Agent must be able to update any detail of a listing including price, status, and specifications.
Changes must be reflected in real-time on the platform.
An audit trail of changes must be maintained and viewable by the agent.

User Stories.Title: User Story 3: Property Listing Deletion
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to delete property listings when they are no longer available or relevant so that potential clients do not waste time on unavailable properties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Agent can delete a listing through their dashboard.
Deleted listings are immediately removed from visible listings on the platform.
A confirmation is required before final deletion to prevent accidental removal.

User Stories.Title: User Story 4: Property Search and Filter
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to search and filter properties based on specific criteria like location, price range, and property type so that I can find suitable listings quickly and efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: Search functionality must allow filtering by location, price range, property type, and other specified parameters.
Results must update in real-time as filters are applied.
Search results should be sortable by price, date listed, and other relevant factors.

User Stories.Title: User Story 5: Bulk Upload of Property Listings
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to bulk upload multiple property listings at once to save time and effort when managing multiple properties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Agents can upload listings using a CSV or similar file format.
The system must validate data format and content before final submission.
An error report should be generated for entries that fail to upload correctly.

User Stories.Title: User Story 6: Listing Analytics Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want access to a dashboard that displays analytics on my property listings, such as number of views, inquiries, and average time to sale or rent, so that I can make informed decisions about how to manage my listings.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard to display key metrics such as views, inquiries, and transaction times.
Analytics are updated in real-time.
Agents can customize the dashboard to display metrics that are most relevant to them.

Real Estate Agents.Title: Transaction Handling
Real Estate Agents.Description: Facilitate the management of transactions for buying, selling, and renting, including capabilities for overseeing offers, negotiations, and closing processes directly from the app.

User Stories.Title: Offer Management
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to manage offers made on properties so that I can efficiently handle negotiations and keep track of multiple offers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to view all offers for each property listing.
Functionality to accept, reject, or counter-offer directly within the app.
Notifications sent to both buyer agents and sellers when an offer is made, modified, or accepted.

User Stories.Title: Contract Signing
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to facilitate the digital signing of contracts so that the closing process can be expedited and managed remotely.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration with secure digital signature technology.
Contracts can be reviewed, edited, and signed by all parties within the app.
Automatic notifications upon each party's signature and final contract completion.

User Stories.Title: Negotiation Communication Tools
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to use integrated communication tools for direct negotiations so that I can effectively communicate between buyers and sellers to speed up the negotiation process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time messaging within the app.
Ability to attach documents and offers directly within communication threads.
History of communications stored for each transaction.

User Stories.Title: Transaction Oversight Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want a dashboard to oversee all transaction statuses so that I can manage multiple transactions efficiently and prioritize actions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays current status of all active transactions.
Alerts and reminders for key transaction milestones and actions required.
Customizable views for sorting and prioritizing transactions.

User Stories.Title: Market Analysis Tool
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want access to real-time market analytics so that I can provide informed advice to my clients and tailor my negotiation strategies based on current market data.
AcceptanceCriteria: Access to real-time data on market trends, pricing, and demand.
Tools to generate custom reports and presentations directly from the app.
Ability to share insights directly with clients through the app.

Real Estate Agents.Title: Client Communication Tools
Real Estate Agents.Description: Develop integrated communication tools within the app to allow real estate agents to maintain continuous and effective communication with clients, including notifications and messaging functionalities.

User Stories.Title: Instant Messaging Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to send and receive instant messages so that I can communicate quickly with clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to send and receive messages in real-time.
Messages are stored securely within the app.
Notifications for new messages are displayed promptly.

User Stories.Title: Push Notifications for Property Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to receive push notifications for property status updates so that I can promptly inform my clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications for changes in property status (e.g., price changes, offer acceptance) are automatically sent.
Agents can customize the types of notifications they receive.
Notifications are visible on both lock screen and within the app.

User Stories.Title: Client Management Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want a dashboard to manage communications with each client so that I can maintain organized and effective interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard to view all communication history with each client.
Ability to sort and filter communication by date, client name, and transaction status.
Quick access to client contact details and communication preferences.

User Stories.Title: Automated Appointment Scheduling
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to automate the scheduling of appointments with clients so that I can optimize my time management.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration with personal and app calendar.
Automatic notifications to clients and agent when an appointment is booked or rescheduled.
Conflict checking to prevent double booking.

User Stories.Title: Secure Document Sharing and Signing
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to share documents securely and facilitate digital signing so that I can expedite transaction processes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Secure uploading and sharing of transaction-related documents.
Support for digital signatures compliant with legal standards.
Real-time updates to both agent and client upon document modifications or signings.

User Stories.Title: Customizable Client Notification System
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to customize the notifications sent to clients so that they receive relevant and timely information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to set preferences for the type and frequency of notifications sent to clients.
Clients can opt-in or opt-out of specific types of notifications.
System confirms notification settings are saved and applied correctly.

Real Estate Agents.Title: Performance Analytics
Real Estate Agents.Description: Provide real estate agents with real-time analytics on property listings and market trends to aid in strategic decision-making and enhance their ability to serve clients effectively.

User Stories.Title: Market Trends Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want access to a dashboard displaying real-time market trends, so that I can make informed decisions and provide up-to-date advice to clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard updates in real-time.
Displays key metrics such as average selling price, days on market, and local demand trends.
Accessible on mobile and desktop platforms.
Data is visually represented through charts and graphs.

User Stories.Title: Property Listing Analytics
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to view detailed analytics for each property listing, so that I can evaluate performance and strategize on how to improve visibility and attract more potential buyers.
AcceptanceCriteria: Individual property listings display real-time views, inquiries, and engagement metrics.
Ability to compare performance against similar listings in the area.
Feature to receive suggestions on improving listing details based on analytics.
Analytics data must be accurate and reflect the latest interactions.

User Stories.Title: Custom Reports Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to generate custom reports based on selected analytics data, so that I can present tailored insights during client meetings and strategic planning sessions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can select specific data points to include in the report.
Reports can be generated in PDF or Excel formats.
Functionality to schedule regular report generation.
Ensures reports include branding and contact information of the agent.

User Stories.Title: Notification System for Market Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to receive notifications for critical market updates, so that I can react promptly to changes in the market environment.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time alerts for significant changes like sharp price adjustments or shifts in buyer demand.
Customizable notification settings to select preferred types of updates.
Notifications can be received via app notifications, email, or SMS.
Provides context and potential implications with each notification.

User Stories.Title: Interactive Data Exploration Tool
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want an interactive tool to explore real-time data, so that I can delve deeper into market statistics and derive specific insights.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tool allows filtering, sorting, and deep dive into specific data segments.
Supports interactive elements like clicking on graphs to view underlying data.
Data is constantly updated to reflect the current market conditions.
User-friendly interface to facilitate ease of use without technical training.

Real Estate Agents.Title: Security and Data Privacy
Real Estate Agents.Description: Ensure robust security measures and data privacy protocols to protect sensitive client information and transaction details, complying with relevant regulations.

User Stories.Title: Agent Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to be able to securely log in to the app using multi-factor authentication so that my account and client information are protected against unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: Login requires username and password.
Second factor authentication via SMS or email is implemented.
After three failed login attempts, the account is temporarily locked.

User Stories.Title: Secure Transaction Management
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want all transactions processed through the app to be encrypted so that sensitive data regarding property sales or purchases is securely handled.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data transmissions are encrypted using industry-standard protocols.
Users receive confirmation notifications when transactions are successfully encrypted.
Regular security audits are conducted to ensure encryption practices are up to date.

User Stories.Title: Data Privacy Compliance Check
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want the app to automatically check compliance with relevant data protection regulations (like GDPR) so that I can assure clients their data is handled legally.
AcceptanceCriteria: The app checks for compliance against a checklist of GDPR requirements.
Compliance reports can be generated from the app.
Non-compliant areas are flagged for immediate review and adjustment.

User Stories.Title: Role-Based Data Access
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to ensure that access to sensitive data is based on user roles so that clients' confidential information is not exposed to unauthorized personnel.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can only access information that pertains to their role.
Attempts to access unauthorized data are logged and reported.
Administrators can update or modify role definitions and access permissions.

User Stories.Title: Secure Client Communication
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want a secure in-app messaging feature for communication with clients so that all interactions are protected and can be conducted with confidentiality.
AcceptanceCriteria: In-app messaging is fully encrypted.
Messages are stored securely and are accessible only to the conversation participants.
Users receive notifications about new messages in a secure manner.

Real Estate Agents.Title: User Training and Support
Real Estate Agents.Description: Offer comprehensive training materials and support systems to help real estate agents adapt to and navigate the new platform, maximizing its utility in their daily operations.

User Stories.Title: Interactive Training Modules
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to access interactive training modules on the platform so that I can learn how to effectively use the app features relevant to my daily tasks.
AcceptanceCriteria: Training modules cover key features such as property listings, transaction management, and communication tools.
Modules include interactive elements like quizzes and simulations.
Progress tracking is available to monitor agents' completion of training modules.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Support Chat
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want access to a real-time support chat so that I can receive immediate assistance with any issues I encounter while using the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Support chat is accessible directly from the app interface.
Support response time is less than 5 minutes during business hours.
Chat includes options to escalate issues to higher support levels if needed.

User Stories.Title: Video Tutorials Library
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want access to a library of video tutorials so that I can visually learn about the platform's features at my own pace.
AcceptanceCriteria: Library includes videos on all main features of the app.
Videos are no longer than 10 minutes each.
Content is updated regularly to reflect updates and new features.

User Stories.Title: Feedback Mechanism on Training Materials
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want the ability to provide feedback on training materials so that the content can be improved and tailored to better meet my learning needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Feedback form is available at the end of each training module and video tutorial.
Feedback data is reviewed monthly to inform updates to the training content.
Agents are notified when updates are made based on agent feedback.

User Stories.Title: Certification Program for Advanced Users
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to participate in a certification program so that I can be recognized as an advanced user, enhancing my professional credibility.
AcceptanceCriteria: Certification program includes advanced modules and assessments.
Certified agents are listed in a directory available on the platform.
Certification is renewed annually based on new assessments and training requirements.

User Stories.Title: Scheduled Live Webinars
User Stories.Description: As a Real Estate Agent, I want to attend scheduled live webinars so that I can interact with trainers and peers to deepen my understanding of complex features.
AcceptanceCriteria: Webinars are scheduled monthly and cover both basic and advanced topics.
Registration for webinars is available directly through the app.
Recordings of webinars are available for those who cannot attend live.

Tenants.Title: Tenant Property Search and Filtering
Tenants.Description: Develop a comprehensive search functionality that allows tenants to search for properties based on various criteria such as location, price, size, and other relevant parameters. Include advanced filtering options to help tenants narrow down their choices efficiently.

User Stories.Title: Basic Property Search
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to search for properties based on primary criteria like location, price, and size so that I can find listings that match my basic housing needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: A search form is available with fields for location, price range, and size.
Search results update dynamically based on the criteria provided.
Each search result includes a brief description, price, and thumbnail image of the property.

User Stories.Title: Advanced Filtering Options
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to use advanced filtering options such as number of bedrooms, property type, and amenities so that I can narrow down search results to properties that closely match my preferences.
AcceptanceCriteria: Advanced filters are available for number of bedrooms, property type (apartment, house, etc.), and amenities (like parking, pool).
Users can apply multiple filters at once.
The search results are updated to reflect only the properties that meet all selected criteria.

User Stories.Title: Save Search and Alerts
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to save my search criteria and set up alerts so that I am notified when new properties matching my criteria are listed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Users can save their search criteria with a custom name.
Users can opt-in to receive alerts via email or push notifications.
Alerts are sent when a new listing matches the saved search criteria.

User Stories.Title: Sort Search Results
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to sort search results by price, size, or date listed so that I can more easily find the most relevant properties.
AcceptanceCriteria: Options to sort search results by price (low to high or high to low), size (small to large or large to small), and date listed (newest or oldest).
The selected sort order is applied immediately to the search results.
The sort criteria can be easily changed with minimal user actions.

User Stories.Title: Property Details and Contact Info
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view detailed information about a property and easily access contact information for the property manager or owner so that I can quickly proceed with inquiries or applications.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each listing provides a detailed page with photos, a full description, and property features.
Contact information for the property owner or manager is clearly displayed.
A button or link to initiate contact (e.g., schedule a viewing or request more info) is prominently placed on the property details page.

Tenants.Title: Rental Application and Lease Management
Tenants.Description: Create a system for tenants to easily apply for rentals and manage lease documents within the app. This system should support uploading necessary documents, digital signing, and tracking the status of their application.

User Stories.Title: Document Upload Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to upload necessary documents directly through the app so that I can conveniently submit all required application materials.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to upload various file types (PDF, DOCX, JPG) for documents such as ID proof, financial statements, and previous rental history.
Confirmation receipt or notification upon successful upload.
Secure storage of uploaded documents with encryption.

User Stories.Title: Digital Signing Capability
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to sign lease agreements digitally within the app so that I can finalize rental agreements without the need for physical paperwork.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration of a secure digital signing tool within the app.
Ability to review the document in full before signing.
Confirmation notification once the document is signed by all parties.

User Stories.Title: Application Status Tracking
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to track the status of my rental application within the app so that I can stay informed about its progress and any next steps required from my side.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time status updates available within the app interface.
Notifications/alerts for any changes in application status, including acceptance, rejection, or need for additional information.
Clear visual indicators (e.g., progress bar) showing the current status of the application.

User Stories.Title: Secure Login and User Authentication
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to securely log into the app with authentication measures so that my personal information and rental documents are protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Login functionality with options for multi-factor authentication.
Password recovery options and security questions.
Automatic logout after a period of inactivity.

User Stories.Title: Lease Document Management
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to easily access and manage all my lease documents in one place within the app so that I can refer back to them as needed without hassle.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to download and view past and current lease agreements.
Organized repository of lease documents sortable by date or property.
Feature to receive and acknowledge any amendments or updates to the lease terms.

Tenants.Title: Communication Tools for Tenant Interactions
Tenants.Description: Implement integrated communication tools that enable tenants to contact property managers and landlords directly through the app for inquiries, issues, or updates related to their rental situation.

User Stories.Title: Direct Messaging Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to send direct messages to my property manager or landlord so that I can quickly address urgent issues or ask questions directly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can initiate a chat with the property manager or landlord directly from the app.
Messages must be delivered in real-time.
The system should maintain a history of all conversations.
Users should receive notifications for new messages.

User Stories.Title: Maintenance Request Submission
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to submit maintenance requests through the app so that I can conveniently report issues without needing to call or email.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can fill out a form in the app to describe the maintenance issue.
Tenants can attach photos or videos to the maintenance request.
The request should be routed directly to the property manager or a designated maintenance handler.
Tenants should receive confirmation of the request submission and be able to track the status of the request.

User Stories.Title: Lease Document Access
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to access my lease documents through the app so that I can refer to the terms of my lease agreement at any time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can view and download their lease documents from the app.
The latest version of the lease should always be available.
Documents should be secured and only accessible to the tenant and authorized personnel.

User Stories.Title: Emergency Contact Information
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to access emergency contact information through the app so that I can quickly reach out in case of urgent situations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Emergency contacts (like fire, police, medical, and property manager’s emergency number) are listed clearly in the app.
The information should be easily accessible from the main menu.
The app should allow dialing directly from the contact list.

User Stories.Title: Notification System for Property Updates
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive notifications for important property updates so that I am always informed about matters affecting my tenancy.
AcceptanceCriteria: The app should send push notifications for important alerts such as maintenance works, security issues, or payment reminders.
Tenants can customize the type of notifications they want to receive.
Notifications should be timely and relevant.

User Stories.Title: Feedback and Rating System
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to provide feedback or rate my property management through the app so that I can share my rental experience and suggest improvements.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenants can submit feedback and rate their satisfaction with the property management directly in the app.
Feedback can include text, ratings, and optionally photos.
Submitted feedback should be reviewable by property managers to initiate potential improvements.

Tenants.Title: Maintenance Request Portal
Tenants.Description: Provide a feature where tenants can report maintenance issues and track the status of their requests. This portal should allow for uploading images or videos, choosing urgency levels, and receiving updates on scheduled repairs.

User Stories.Title: Issue Reporting Interface
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to be able to report maintenance issues through an easy-to-use interface so that I can quickly communicate problems to the property management.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can access the issue reporting feature through the app.
The interface provides fields for issue description, location within the property, and an option to categorize the issue type.
The submission button is clearly visible and responsive.

User Stories.Title: Upload Images and Videos
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to upload images or videos of the maintenance issue so that I can visually communicate the problem to enhance the understanding of the issue.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can upload multiple images or a video along with the maintenance request.
Uploaded media should be previewable before submission.
The system confirms successful upload with a visual indication.

User Stories.Title: Select Urgency Level
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to select an urgency level for my maintenance request so that the property management can prioritize the issue based on its severity.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can choose from predefined urgency levels such as Low, Medium, and High.
The selected urgency level is highlighted or clearly displayed once selected.
Information about what each urgency level means is accessible within the feature.

User Stories.Title: Track Request Status
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to track the status of my maintenance requests so that I can stay informed on the progress and estimated time for resolution.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant can view a list of their active and past maintenance requests.
Each request in the list shows the current status (e.g., Submitted, In Progress, Completed).
Tenant receives notifications when the status of their request changes.

User Stories.Title: Receive Updates on Scheduled Repairs
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive updates about scheduled repairs for my maintenance requests so that I can be prepared for the repair activities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Tenant is notified of the scheduled date and time for repairs via the app.
Tenant can confirm or request a reschedule of the repair appointment through the app.
Tenant receives a reminder notification 24 hours before the scheduled repair.

Tenants.Title: Payment System Integration
Tenants.Description: Develop a secure payment gateway for tenants to pay rent and other property-related fees. This system should support various payment methods and provide reminders and receipts for transactions.

User Stories.Title: Secure Login for Payment Portal
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to securely log in to the payment portal so that I can authenticate my identity and protect my account from unauthorized access.
AcceptanceCriteria: Login page must provide input fields for username and password.
Support for multi-factor authentication.
System locks account after three unsuccessful login attempts.
Successful login redirects to the payment dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Multiple Payment Options
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to choose from various payment methods (credit card, debit card, bank transfer, digital wallets) so that I can pay using my preferred payment method.
AcceptanceCriteria: Payment page must list all available payment methods.
System must process transactions securely using encrypted data transmission.
Provide confirmation screen before finalizing the transaction.
Successful payment generates a digital receipt.

User Stories.Title: Rent Payment Reminder Notifications
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive reminders for upcoming rent payments so that I can ensure timely payment and avoid late fees.
AcceptanceCriteria: System sends automatic email and SMS reminders 7 days and 3 days before the due date.
Reminders must include the amount due and the due date.
Option for tenants to customize the reminder settings.
Ability to dismiss or snooze reminders.

User Stories.Title: Transaction History and Receipts
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to view my payment history and download receipts so that I can keep track of my payments and have documentation for my records.
AcceptanceCriteria: Payment dashboard must include a section for past transactions.
Each transaction record must include date, amount, and payment method.
Provide an option to download receipts in PDF format.
Filters to search and sort transaction history by date and amount.

User Stories.Title: Real-time Payment Confirmation
User Stories.Description: As a Tenant, I want to receive real-time confirmation of my rent payments so that I can be assured my payment has been successfully processed.
AcceptanceCriteria: Upon successful payment, display a confirmation screen with transaction details.
Send a confirmation email with the receipt attached.
Update the tenant's balance and due date immediately in the system.
Option to print the confirmation page.

Service Providers.Title: Service Booking Management
Service Providers.Description: Develop a robust system within the app that allows service providers to manage bookings, schedule appointments, and track service requests from property managers and owners efficiently.

User Stories.Title: User Story 1: Service Provider Login
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to be able to log in securely to the app so that I can access my personalized dashboard and manage bookings.
AcceptanceCriteria: Login page must be accessible to Service Providers.
Authentication must use secure protocols like OAuth.
Upon successful login, the user should be redirected to a personalized dashboard.

User Stories.Title: User Story 2: View Booking Requests
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to view a list of booking requests from property managers and owners so that I can manage my schedule and respond accordingly.
AcceptanceCriteria: A list view of all current booking requests should be available.
Each item in the list must include essential details like service type, date, time, and requester contact info.
The list should be sortable by date and filterable by status (pending, confirmed, completed).

User Stories.Title: User Story 3: Accept or Reject Booking Requests
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to accept or reject booking requests so that I can effectively manage my workload and schedule.
AcceptanceCriteria: Options to accept or reject should be easily accessible from each booking request item.
Upon accepting or rejecting a request, the requester should receive a notification.
The system must update the booking status accordingly in real-time.

User Stories.Title: User Story 4: Schedule Appointments
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to schedule appointments directly in the app so that I can efficiently manage my time and resources.
AcceptanceCriteria: A calendar view should be available to add, view, and manage appointments.
The app should allow dragging and dropping of appointment blocks to adjust times.
Alerts should be set up to remind both the service provider and the client 24 hours before the appointment.

User Stories.Title: User Story 5: Track Service Request Status
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to track the status of service requests so that I can keep clients updated and manage expectations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Each service request should have a status indicator (e.g., pending, in progress, completed).
Service Providers should be able to update the status manually.
Clients should receive real-time notifications when the status of their service request changes.

User Stories.Title: User Story 6: Access Real-Time Analytics
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want access to real-time analytics on my bookings and services so that I can make informed decisions about my business.
AcceptanceCriteria: Analytics dashboard should include data on booking trends, cancellation rates, and customer feedback.
The dashboard must be updated in real-time.
Analytics should be exportable for reporting purposes.

User Stories.Title: User Story 7: Manage Client Communications
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to communicate efficiently with clients through the app so that I can resolve queries and ensure customer satisfaction.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integrated messaging system within the app.
Notification alerts for new messages.
Ability to attach files and send automated responses.

Service Providers.Title: Service Listing and Promotion
Service Providers.Description: Create features that enable service providers to list their services, including descriptions, availability, and pricing, and promote their offerings to targeted real estate stakeholders within the app.

User Stories.Title: Service Listing Creation
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to create listings for my services including descriptions, availability, and pricing, so that I can offer my services to real estate stakeholders directly through the app.
AcceptanceCriteria: Service Providers can input service descriptions, availability dates, and pricing information.
Each listing must include fields for service type, cost, and a calendar for availability.
The app should validate the input data for format and mandatory fields before submission.

User Stories.Title: Service Listing Management
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to manage my service listings, including updating details or removing services, so that I can keep my offerings current and accurate.
AcceptanceCriteria: Service Providers can edit all fields of their service listings.
Service Providers can deactivate or delete their service listings.
Changes must be updated in real-time in the app’s database.

User Stories.Title: Service Promotion to Targeted Stakeholders
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to promote my services to targeted real estate stakeholders such as property managers and real estate agents, so that I can increase my service visibility and usage.
AcceptanceCriteria: Service Providers can select target audiences within the app for promotional activities.
The app should provide options to customize promotional messages or offers.
Promotions should be trackable within the app to monitor reach and engagement.

User Stories.Title: Service Booking Integration
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want potential clients to be able to book my services through the app, so that I can streamline the booking process and improve client conversion rates.
AcceptanceCriteria: Integration of a booking system within the service listings.
Real-time availability updates to prevent double bookings.
Confirmation notifications to both Service Provider and client upon successful booking.

User Stories.Title: Review and Ratings for Services
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to enable clients to leave reviews and ratings for my services, so that I can build credibility and attract more clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can rate services on a scale of 1 to 5 and leave text reviews.
Ratings and reviews should be visible on the service listing for all users.
Service Providers can respond to reviews to engage with clients.

User Stories.Title: Service Provider Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want access to a dashboard that tracks my service performance metrics, so that I can make informed business decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard should include metrics such as number of bookings, cancellations, ratings average, and revenue generated.
Data should be displayed in an easy-to-understand format, such as charts and graphs.
Dashboard updates in real-time to reflect the most current data.

Service Providers.Title: Communication Tools Integration
Service Providers.Description: Implement integrated communication tools that enable service providers to communicate directly with clients (property owners, managers, and tenants) to discuss services, negotiate contracts, and provide updates.

User Stories.Title: Secure Messaging Feature
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want a secure messaging feature so that I can safely communicate with property owners, managers, and tenants regarding service details.
AcceptanceCriteria: Messages must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
Only authenticated users can send and receive messages.
Users should receive notifications for new messages.

User Stories.Title: Contract Negotiation Tool
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want a tool to negotiate contracts directly within the app so that I can swiftly finalize agreements with clients.
AcceptanceCriteria: The tool should allow editing and sharing contract drafts in real-time.
Both parties should be able to sign the contract digitally within the platform.
All contract changes must be tracked and time-stamped for auditing purposes.

User Stories.Title: Service Scheduling System
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to schedule services directly through the app so that I can efficiently manage appointments and availability.
AcceptanceCriteria: Service providers and clients can view available times and book appointments.
Both parties receive confirmation notifications once an appointment is booked.
The system should allow rescheduling and cancellations with appropriate notifications.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Updates and Alerts
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to send real-time updates and alerts to clients about service status so that they are always informed about the progress or changes.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must allow sending instant updates about service status.
Clients should be able to opt-in for SMS or email notifications.
Updates should also be visible within the app's dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Document Sharing and Management
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want a feature to share and manage service-related documents within the app so that all relevant documents are accessible in one place.
AcceptanceCriteria: The feature must support uploading, downloading, and viewing documents.
Documents should be categorized by type and transaction for easy retrieval.
Appropriate security measures must be in place to protect document confidentiality.

User Stories.Title: Feedback and Rating System
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want a feedback and rating system so that I can receive client feedback on services provided, enhancing credibility and service quality.
AcceptanceCriteria: Clients can rate services and leave feedback via the app.
Feedback should be visible to the service provider and, optionally, to other clients.
The system should aggregate ratings to provide an overall score for each service provider.

Service Providers.Title: Transaction Management for Service Providers
Service Providers.Description: Develop a transaction management system specifically for service providers to process payments securely, generate invoices, and manage financial records within the app.

User Stories.Title: Secure Payment Processing
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to process payments securely so that both my business and the clients' financial information are protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: Implement end-to-end encryption for all payment transactions.
Ensure the system complies with relevant financial regulations (e.g., PCI DSS).
Payment processing should be integrated with major credit card providers and payment gateways.
Users should receive confirmation of payment through the app.

User Stories.Title: Invoice Generation
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to automatically generate invoices after each transaction so that I can provide clients with a detailed record of charges and services.
AcceptanceCriteria: Invoices should automatically generate after a transaction is completed.
Invoices should include detailed information such as date, services provided, amounts charged, and tax details.
Allow users to customize the invoice template.
Invoices can be sent to clients via email or available for download as PDF.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Financial Reporting
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to access real-time financial reports so that I can make informed decisions about my business operations.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system must provide reports on daily, weekly, and monthly earnings.
Reports should include visualization charts and the ability to filter by date range and service type.
Ensure data accuracy and real-time updates as transactions occur.
Users should be able to export reports in various formats (e.g., CSV, Excel, PDF).

User Stories.Title: Record Management System
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want a management system to keep track of all transaction records so that I can easily reference past transactions and maintain organized records.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should store all transaction data securely.
Allow users to search, filter, and sort through transaction records using multiple parameters (e.g., date, client name, amount).
Users must be able to access transaction history from their mobile devices.
Ensure compliance with data privacy laws for storing and accessing transaction records.

User Stories.Title: Multi-Currency Support
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider operating internationally, I want the system to support multiple currencies so that I can easily conduct transactions with clients overseas.
AcceptanceCriteria: The payment system should automatically detect and convert currencies based on client location.
Provide accurate, real-time currency conversion rates.
The system should display prices and process payments in both the local and client's preferred currency.
Ensure that all financial reports can reflect multiple currencies and provide conversions based on the current exchange rate.

Service Providers.Title: Performance Analytics Dashboard
Service Providers.Description: Provide a dashboard for service providers that delivers real-time analytics on their service usage, client satisfaction ratings, and financial performance to help them optimize their operations.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Service Usage Analytics
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to view real-time analytics on my service usage so that I can identify trends and adjust my offerings accordingly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Real-time data refresh capabilities
