Visual representation of data (graphs, charts)
Ability to filter data by date, service type, and location

User Stories.Title: Client Satisfaction Ratings Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to access a dashboard that displays client satisfaction ratings so that I can gauge the quality of my services and identify areas for improvement.
AcceptanceCriteria: Display overall satisfaction score
Breakdown of ratings by service type
Feature to view customer feedback comments

User Stories.Title: Financial Performance Monitoring
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to monitor my financial performance through the dashboard so that I can make informed financial decisions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Display of key financial metrics (revenue, expenses, profit)
Comparison of current performance against historical data
Alerts for significant financial changes

User Stories.Title: Customizable Dashboard Settings
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to customize the layout and widgets of my analytics dashboard so that I can focus on the information most relevant to me.
AcceptanceCriteria: Ability to add, remove, or rearrange widgets
Save custom settings for future use
User-friendly interface for customization

User Stories.Title: Export Data Functionality
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want the ability to export data from the dashboard so that I can perform detailed analysis offline or share it with my team.
AcceptanceCriteria: Support for exporting data in CSV, Excel, and PDF formats
Exported data includes all filters and customizations applied
Secure data handling during export

Service Providers.Title: Feedback and Ratings System
Service Providers.Description: Integrate a feedback and ratings system that allows property owners, managers, and tenants to rate services provided, thereby helping service providers improve service quality and reputation within the platform.

User Stories.Title: Create Rating Submission Form
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to have a form where property owners, managers, and tenants can submit ratings and feedback, so that I can gather data on the quality of services provided.
AcceptanceCriteria: A form is accessible to property owners, managers, and tenants after service completion.
The form includes options for rating various aspects of the service (such as timeliness, professionalism, and overall satisfaction).
Users can submit comments along with their ratings.
Submissions are timestamped and linked to the user's profile and specific service transaction.

User Stories.Title: View Ratings Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to view a dashboard summarizing all feedback and ratings, so that I can quickly assess service performance areas and identify improvement opportunities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard is accessible to Service Providers from their main account page.
Dashboard displays average ratings and recent comments.
Providers can filter results by date range, service type, or specific properties.
Visual indicators or alerts highlight ratings that fall below a certain threshold.

User Stories.Title: Respond to Feedback
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want the ability to respond to feedback directly within the app, so that I can address customer concerns and demonstrate commitment to service quality.
AcceptanceCriteria: Service Providers can reply to comments from the ratings dashboard.
Replies are visible to the user who left the feedback and can be made private or public.
The system notifies the user when a response has been made to their feedback.

User Stories.Title: Receive Notifications on New Ratings
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to receive notifications when new ratings and feedback are submitted, so that I can stay updated on customer satisfaction in real-time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Notifications are sent to Service Providers via email or through the app’s notification system.
Service Providers can customize notification settings (e.g., frequency, types of feedback to be alerted about).
Each notification links directly to the detailed feedback in the dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Feedback Trends
User Stories.Description: As a Service Provider, I want to utilize tools for analyzing feedback trends over time, so that I can make data-driven decisions to enhance service quality.
AcceptanceCriteria: The app includes analytics tools capable of tracking and displaying feedback trends.
Service Providers can generate reports based on custom criteria (e.g., time period, service category).
The system provides recommendations based on analytics, like areas for improvement or training needs for staff.
